name: Druid
description: Whether a shaman from a remote tribe or an isolated hermit, a druid reveres, worships, and protects nature. Nature rewards this special connection by allowing the druid to practice unique and powerful forms of magic, such as transforming into various animals.
backstoryPrompts: How did you become a druid?
Are you connected to a formal druid circle, or do you work on your own?
How would you describe your relationship with nature?
What does it take to cultivate such a close connection with nature?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
coreAbilityDescription: You have the ability to transform into a variety of animals. The willpower required to do so is dependent on the animal chosen.
limitations: As a druid, you begin with deficiency in two of these three skills: {{skills.defense}}, {{skills.literacy}}, {{skills.legerdemain}}.

levelingBonuses.1: gain proficiency in {{skills.medicine}} or {{skills.survival}}. This skill becomes your supporting skill.
levelingBonuses.5: your proficiency in {{skills.nature}} and your supporting skill increase to expertise.
levelingBonuses.10: Your proficiency in {{skills.nature}} and your supporting skill increase to mastery.

_: A pair of sandals or moccasins
